title.hr: Kvote: meko i tvrdo ograničenje, razdoblje odgode
title.en: Disk quotas: soft and hard limit, grace period

concept.hr: Meko se smije prijeći dok traje razdoblje odgode; tvrdo zaustavlja pisanje
concept.en: Soft limit: passable while the grace period runs; the hard limit stops the write

summary.hr: Korisnica piše datoteke na datotečni sustav s kvotom, a dani prolaze: tvrdo ograničenje, sat razdoblja odgode, istek roka, brisanje i broj datoteka.
summary.en: A user writes files on a filesystem with a quota while days pass: the hard limit, the grace clock, the deadline, deleting, and the number of files.

title.en: Quotas: when the grace period runs out

concept.hr: Nakon roka meko je ograničenje zid: ni 1 MiB ne prolazi, iako je ispod tvrdog
concept.en: After the deadline the soft limit is a wall: 1 MiB fails, though below hard

concept.hr: Puna kvota na /mnt/polje ne smeta pisanju na /home istog stroja
concept.en: A full quota on /mnt/polje does not stop writes to /home on the same machine
